summary: Expanded the node through an underfollowed discovery lens. The most investable public-market mappings are not pure election-machine vendors, which are mostly private, but adjacent government-software, digital-investigation, credentialing/PKI, biometrics, and public-safety infrastructure vendors. Reference lane: Tyler Technologies as a large-cap context anchor for state/local public-sector software and public-safety CAD/RMS.
